Running the same checks outside the sandbox succeeded with RELEASE_OBSERVED. Installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163 and Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; official available tags v1.0.0-rc.1 and tasks-dev-20260929.2. Expected either an actionable unsupported-sandbox explanation or documentation of the process-observation permission prerequisite, while preserving fail-closed verification. No update or bypass occurred. Dedup searches for descendant snapshot and sandbox did not find this exact diagnostic. Reproduction evidence retained in orchestration chat 01a0f4d6-ea40-78f3-ade1-6fc6d8da731c; coordinator is the only native writer.

2026-10-01 additional reviewer observation (same diagnostic, deduplicated here): in /private/tmp/corvint-orchestrator-pr438-review, installed Core rc.1 build163 / Tasks developer build202, `corvint-update check --allow-network` exited 1 with `version smoke failed: process-after-start-failed: descendant snapshot unavailable`; JSON component core, freshness UNKNOWN, qualification release evidence only/no broad qualification/atomic visibility/no power-loss durability guarantee, publisherIdentity NOT_VERIFIED. Tool-output transcription (not a new rerun) retained at /private/tmp/pr438-corvint-update-observed.txt. Parent explicit component checks outside the restricted sandbox succeeded with RELEASE_OBSERVED and current official tags v1.0.0-rc.1 / tasks-dev-20260929.2. This is suspected tooling/environment friction, not a confirmed updater defect or evidence of surviving descendants. Exact reviewer permission boundary is NOT_OBSERVED; reproduce or qualify that difference before attributing it to the sandbox. Expected supported smoke or actionable unsupported-environment boundary; actual unavailable snapshot plus UNKNOWN freshness. No update, bypass or source repair performed.
